memoryRule: a complete three-station route opens its source, transfers its contour to a distant relay, and bends a third hinge station; later routes inherit the altered station field
interactionRule: drag through three distinct stations; the first two crossings remain geometry-neutral; release commits; Enter, Space, and the trace control use a deterministic route; Delete lifts latest; R or Escape releases
representationRupture: sentence sheet, word archipelago, and pressure loom -> sparse SVG route organism of eleven letter-stations
encounterRupture: typed glyph offer, wandering census, and duration hold -> one uninterrupted three-station drag with release as the causal event
temporalRupture: sentence refusal, latent attention, and pressure debt -> bounded route memory whose source/relay/hinge rewrite compounds across distance
mediumRupture: semantic DOM sentence and Canvas pressure field -> inline SVG station paths with actual route geometry
renderer: deterministic inline SVG typographic route field
changedRule: A completed route changes three distant letter-stations rather than marking the touched letter.
visibleConsequence: Actual station paths, positions, contours, glyph inheritance, roles, and connecting routes change after a valid three-station route; the first two crossings remain exact.
falsifier: Delete if one crossing commits, if the touched station is always the answer, if remote roles are only UI, if later routes reset, or if lifting is inexact.
deletionCondition: Delete v031 if the blind field reads as a generic node diagram, keyboard, or decorative SVG map instead of a typographic route organism.
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
